home.subtitle: What would you like to do today?
home.empty_body: When you report a problem, you can follow it here.
home.verify_body: The office says the work is done. Tell us if it really is.
home.nearby_empty: No open issues near you right now.

track.title: Track a complaint
track.subtitle: Enter your ticket ID and 6-digit PIN. No login needed.
track.not_found: We could not find a complaint with that ticket and PIN.

login.title: Sign in to JanaVaani
login.magic_sent: Check your email for the sign-in link.
login.brand_body: Report a problem in your own language and follow it until it is really fixed.
login.guest_hint: Guests get a ticket ID and a 6-digit PIN to track their complaint without an account.

onboarding.title: Choose your language
onboarding.subtitle: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.more_languages_body: You can also speak or type in these languages. The AI understands them and replies in them; screens stay in English.
onboarding.consent_subtitle: Here is what JanaVaani does with your information.

consent.store: We store your complaint, any photos you add, and the location you share, only to resolve your complaint. You can report anonymously.
consent.ai: AI translates your words, suggests the department and priority, and summarizes the case for officers. AI-made content is marked.
consent.humans: People make the decisions that matter: emergencies, critical priority, unclear routing and disputed closures.

onboarding.optional: Optional. You can change this later.
onboarding.synthetic_note: This is a demo: all complaints shown are synthetic.
onboarding.a11y_subtitle: Pick anything that helps. You can change these any time in Settings.

a11y.voice_first: Speak instead of type, hear replies

settings.reply_language_hint: Officer messages and bot replies reach you in this language.
settings.motion_hint: Follow your phone, always reduce, or always animate.
settings.low_literacy_hint: Fewer words, more pictures and voice.
settings.voice_first_hint: Start new reports with the microphone.
settings.autoplay_hint: Plays every bot and officer message automatically.
settings.voice_sample: Your complaint has been registered. We will keep you updated.
settings.voice_yes: A voice is installed for this language
settings.voice_no: No voice installed; we try the server voice
settings.anonymous_hint: Officers will not see your name.
settings.perm_hint: Your browser asks before the first use.

ai_uses.translate: Translates your words and officer replies
ai_uses.priority: Suggests a priority, with reasons you can see

notifications.empty_body: Updates about your complaints will appear here.

asset.title: Report a problem with this asset

report.title: Report a problem
report.greet: Tell me what the problem is. You can type or speak in any language: Telugu, Hindi, Urdu, English or a mix.
report.error_send: That did not go through. Please try again.
report.photo_retake_hint: This photo may be hard for the officer to see. Want to take a clearer one?

location.title: Where is the problem?
location.subtitle: An exact spot helps the right team reach it faster.
location.gps_hint: Use your phone's location if you are standing at the problem.
location.denied: Location is blocked. Pick on the map or type a landmark instead.
location.gps_error: Could not get your location. Try the map instead.
location.drag_hint: Drag the pin or tap the map to move it.
location.landmark_placeholder: e.g. opposite the temple, Miyapur X Roads

confirm.title: Please check your complaint
confirm.needs_review: The AI is not sure about the department. A supervisor will check it before it is assigned.
confirm.critical_note: Critical complaints are confirmed by a person before the 4-hour emergency deadline applies.
confirm.no_location: No location yet. Adding one helps the team find it.
confirm.anonymous_hint: Officers will not see your name. You can still track the complaint.
confirm.private_hint: Your complaint will not appear on public maps or nearby lists.

split.subtitle: Each one goes to the right department with its own ticket. Untick any you don't want to register.

dup.title: People nearby already reported this
dup.subtitle: Adding your support raises its priority and you get the same updates.
dup.notified: You'll be notified when it's fixed.

emergency.title: This sounds like an emergency
emergency.critical_note: Your complaint is marked critical and sent to the emergency review team.

submitted.subtitle: The right office has it now. We will keep you updated.
submitted.save_pin: Save this PIN. With the ticket ID it lets you track the complaint without an account.

receipt.title: Complaint receipt
receipt.qr_alt: QR code to track this complaint
receipt.footer: JanaVaani · Demo data only · This receipt is generated from the complaint record; the timeline is tamper-evident.
